question: Which method best characterises the approach of the Moderates?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Petition and prayer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Moderates** were early leaders of the Indian National Congress, who believed in achieving political reform through peaceful and constitutional methods.
 
• Their approach was characterized by **petitioning the British Government** to address grievances, promoting dialogue, and seeking justice through legal and administrative frameworks.
